reuse.why: Computes the field with the existing shared getScheduledAmount used by forecasts, previews and the client.

duplication.why: No logic duplicated; the amount rule is not re-implemented.

placement.why: The field is added in the api/schedules-get handler with its own list type in api-models; it could arguably sit in the scheduleModel mapping, but keeping toExternal unchanged for other endpoints is reasonable.

scope.why: Only the list endpoint, its type and its test change.

maintainability.why: Small, typed addition that follows any future change to the shared amount rule automatically.
